report.notes: snapshot.js selectionOf() now runs each selected text node's parent through the page walker's visible() check, sharing its cache. It skips hidden, aria-hidden, tiny, transparent, off-screen and script/style/noscript/template text, counts it as hidden_text and puts a space in its place. New fixtures: tests/assist/fixtures/hidden_selection_page.html and run_hidden_selection.cjs, which select in real Chromium by Ctrl+A, mouse drag and a range. On 20a646f all 4 new tests fail (the selection contains the hidden instruction, the e-mail and the CSRF token); with the fix they pass, and all 2148 tests in tests/assist pass. If a selection contains only hidden text that String(getSelection()) still reports (e.g. opacity:0), the selection is empty and selection_withheld is set to true, which fails closed. graphify update was not run because graphify-out/ is outside the permitted paths.
